answer.original_source: Wendell Weeks, Corning Chairman, CEO and President, speaking to Fox News Digital on 2026-07-01
answer.new_information: Weeks's remark is a hedged ambition, not a sized figure: 'We will probably double our size over the coming years'. The period and the metric of 'size' (revenue, capacity or headcount) are not stated. The NVIDIA-Corning figures (3,000+ jobs across North Carolina and Texas, tenfold US optical capacity, three facilities) are Fox News relays of an earlier-2026 project with no completion date and no stated source of their own in the text. The Wistron Texas item is unquantified and undated. No stored piece or catalog question exists to which these bear, so there is nothing to revise, oppose or match.
